title: ANTs Composite Transform Build

fixed_image.desc: Fixed (target / reference) image the moving image is registered into.

moving_image.desc: Moving (source) image to register into the fixed image space.

output_prefix.desc: Prefix prepended to all generated artifacts (e.g. '<prefix>Composite.h5').

preset.desc: Registration preset expanded into staged antsRegistration transforms.

fixed_mask.desc: Optional mask restricting metric sampling in the fixed image.

moving_mask.desc: Optional mask restricting metric sampling in the moving image.

random_seed.desc: Fixed seed for deterministic, reproducible registration.

precision.desc: Computation precision; 'float' is faster and lower-memory.

interpolation.desc: Interpolation used when resampling the warped QC image.

description: High-level transform-build surface: registers a moving image to a fixed image with a preset staged antsRegistration pipeline and writes a composite .h5 transform (plus its inverse and a warped QC image) with deterministic, prefix-derived output paths.
